title: DOAS extinction-domain retrieval benchmark, v2 (261 synthetic BBCEAS spectra with known truth)

creators.name: Lee, HwanKyung
creators.affiliation: Gwangju Institute of Science and Technology (GIST), Republic of Korea

description: 261 synthetic extinction spectra with known truth for testing DOAS-style retrieval codes, in two instrument windows (hot_PNs 444.146–470.685 nm, cold 438.42–475.741 nm). Three of the five case groups test whether the uncertainty a code reports is right and whether the answer survives a change of fitting window. Includes the generator (seed 20260921), a reference implementation and a scorer. Cross sections are instrument-convolved from Vandaele et al. (NO2), Volkamer et al. (CHOCHO) and HITRAN (H2O); cite the original cross-section papers. Change from v1: the H2O cross section was re-assembled from HITRAN line data and peaks 2.5 % higher in the fitting windows.
